messages:
michael: Customer reports after upgrading to @redwood/sdk v0.23 their chat call now returns 404 'route not found: /v1/chat.create'. Example from them:

```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-alpha', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] });
```

They say it worked on v0.22. Error: 404 with body `{"error":"route not found","route":"/v1/chat.create"}`.

josh-cs: Can you confirm SDK version & which region (us-east1/us-west1)? Also need the exact response body and headers if possible.

customer-dev: SDK: 0.23.1, region: us-east1. Full response: 404, `{"error":"route not found","route":"/v1/chat.create","request_id":"req_01xyz"}`. Headers: x-rw-api-version: 2026-03-01

ava-eng: Hmm, 0.23 changed the client to call `POST /v1/chat.generate` (new route) but should still shim `chat.create` for all regions. Asking @maya for recent deploy notes.

maya: quick check: we did a staged rollout of the compat shim last week but rolled back on us-east1 due to perf. If customer upgraded SDK which now expects server shim, but us-east1 rollback removed shim -> 404. Suggest either downgrade SDK to 0.22.x or change call to `client.request('POST','/v1/chat.generate',...)` as workaround.

michael: Can we give them exact downgrade pin command and a quick repro curl for the workaround?

ava-eng: Downgrade npm: `npm install @redwood/sdk@0.22.4` or use yarn. Quick curl fallback:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat.generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}] }'
```

josh-cs: Also note param rename in 0.23: some clients send `conversation_id` -> server expects `session_id` in the new route. If they move to chat.generate they need to ensure param rename.

customer-dev: Ok pinning to 0.22.4 now, will report back. Any ETA on shim re-enable in us-east1?

maya: Eng has a ticket RW-INF-3421. ETA 24-48h depending on validation. I'll add this customer to the incident so we can notify when fixed.

support-bot: Added customer 'acme-infra' to RW-INF-3421. Estimated resolution: 48h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

michael: Thanks — keep thread updated. If they hit other errors (auth/billing headers) we'll take next steps.
